name: StatCard
description: A dashboard KPI card whose headline number counts up with an ease-out curve while a gradient-filled sparkline draws itself in and an end-point dot pops on. A colored delta badge shows the change versus the previous period, with an option to treat decreases as good.
a11yNotes: The card is a <section> labelled by its title. The counting number is aria-hidden and the final formatted value is provided as visually hidden text, so screen readers never hear intermediate values. The delta badge includes visually hidden 'Up'/'Down' text (color is not the only cue; the arrow icon also changes). The sparkline is role="img" with an aria-label summarising the range. Under prefers-reduced-motion the value appears immediately and the sparkline is drawn statically.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Metric name; also the card's accessible name.

propsApi.name: value
propsApi.description: Final value the number counts up to.

propsApi.name: delta
propsApi.description: Percent change versus the previous period; negative values point down.

propsApi.name: deltaLabel
propsApi.description: Comparison text under the value (empty hides the line).

propsApi.name: invertDelta
propsApi.description: Treat a decrease as good (green) — for churn, latency, costs.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Sparkline stroke, fill and card glow color.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Count-up and draw-in duration in milliseconds (0 = instant).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
